title: Introduction to sumExtras
text: ’ve worked gtsummary , ’re familiar typical workflow building summary tables: creating base table tbl_summary(), progressively adding features like overall columns, p-values, formatting tweaks. gtsummary’s modular approach provides flexibility, sequence functions appears repeatedly analysis scripts. extras() consolidates common gtsummary formatting steps one call: bold labels, clean header, overall column, p-values, missing value cleanup. Standard gtsummary sumExtras
code: theme_gtsummary_compact("jama")  trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt) |>   add_overall() |>   add_p() |>   bold_labels() |>   bold_p() |>   modify_header(label = "") use_jama_theme()  trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt) |>   extras()

title: Introduction to sumExtras
text: can control features applied: pass arguments list reuse across tables: non-stratified tables, extras() skips add_overall() add_p() applies formatting makes sense. works way tbl_regression() — bold labels, bold significant p-values (model), clean header, missing value cleanup applied automatically irrelevant options silently ignored. never breaks pipeline. merged tables, call extras() sub-table merging. formatting (bold labels, p-values, missing symbols) carries tbl_merge(), ’s need call extras() :
code: # Without p-values trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt) |>   extras(pval = FALSE) # Overall column last instead of first trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt) |>   extras(last = TRUE) # Custom header text trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt) |>   extras(header = "Variable") my_args <- list(pval = TRUE, overall = TRUE, last = TRUE)  trial |>   select(age, grade, stage, trt) |>   tbl_summary(by = trt) |>   extras(.args = my_args) # Regression tables work too glm(response ~ age + grade, data = trial, family = binomial) |>   tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE) |>   extras() t1 <- trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt, include = c(age, grade)) |>   extras()  t2 <- trial |>   tbl_summary(by = trt, include = c(marker, stage)) |>   extras()  tbl_merge(list(t1, t2), tab_spanner = c("**Set A**", "**Set B**"))

text: sumExtras reduces repetitive boilerplate gtsummary workflows. One function replaces five. Stop copy-pasting add_overall(), add_p(), bold_labels(), modify_header() every table. title: Standardize missing value display across all gtsummary table types — clean_table
text: Replaces various missing value representations consistent symbol (default "---") easier tell actual data missing undefined values. Works gtsummary table types, including stacked tables (tbl_strata) survey-weighted summaries (tbl_svysummary). Handles tables without standard var_type column.

title: Standardize missing value display across all gtsummary table types — clean_table
text: tbl gtsummary table object (e.g., tbl_summary(), tbl_svysummary(), tbl_regression(), tbl_strata()) symbol Character string replace missing values . Default "---" (em-dash style). Common alternatives: "\u2014" (em-dash), "\u2013" (en-dash), "--", "N/".

title: Standardize missing value display across all gtsummary table types — clean_table
text: gtsummary table object standardized missing value display

title: Standardize missing value display across all gtsummary table types — clean_table
text: function uses gtsummary::modify_table_body() transform character columns replace missing, undefined, zero-valued patterns consistent symbol. Matched patterns include: Literal NA Inf / -Inf values Count/percent pairs: "0 (0%)", "0 (NA%)", "0 (NA)", "NA (0)", "NA (NA)" Decimal variants: "0.00 (0.00)", "0.00% (0.00)", "0% (0.000)" Paired values: "NA, NA" Confidence intervals: "NA (NA, NA)", "0% (0.000) (0%, 0%)", "0.00 (0.00) (0.00, 0.00)", similar zero-CI patterns Replacing patterns single symbol keeps table easier read. Note: function checks presence var_type column applying modify_missing_symbol(). allows work tbl_strata objects use var_type_1, var_type_2, etc. instead var_type.

title: Add standard styling and formatting to gtsummary tables — extras
text: Applies consistent set formatting options gtsummary tables including overall column, bold labels, clean headers, optional p-values. Wraps common workflow adding multiple formatting functions one call. Always succeeds applying works warning rest.

title: Add standard styling and formatting to gtsummary tables — extras
code: extras(   tbl,   pval = TRUE,   overall = TRUE,   last = FALSE,   header = "",   symbol = "---",   .args = NULL,   .add_p_args = NULL )

title: Add standard styling and formatting to gtsummary tables — extras
text: tbl gtsummary table object (e.g., tbl_summary(), tbl_regression()) pval Logical indicating whether add p-values. Default TRUE. TRUE, uses gtsummary's default statistical tests (Kruskal-Wallis continuous variables 3+ groups, chi-square categorical variables). overall Logical indicating whether add overall column last Logical indicating Overall column last. Aligns default gtsummary::add_overall(). header Character string label column header. Default "" (blank). Use "Characteristic" custom text. symbol Character string missing value replacement clean_table(). Default "---". Passed directly clean_table(symbol = ...). .args Optional list arguments use instead individual parameters. provided, overrides pval, overall, last, header, symbol arguments. .add_p_args Optional named list arguments pass gtsummary::add_p(). Allows customization statistical tests p-value formatting. User-provided arguments override default arguments (pvalue_fun test.args). See gtsummary::add_p() documentation available arguments.

title: Add standard styling and formatting to gtsummary tables — extras

title: sumExtras 1.0.0 (2026-02-09)
text: Removed apply_labels_from_dictionary(). Use attr(data$var, "label") <- "Label" directly, labelled package bulk attribute labeling.

title: sumExtras 1.0.0 (2026-02-09)
text: extras() auto-labeling via options(sumExtras.auto_labels = TRUE) (recommended) options(sumExtras.prefer_dictionary = TRUE). See vignette("options"). extras() now bolds significant p-values (bold_p()) automatically p-values added. New header parameter extras() controls label column header text (default ""). New symbol parameter clean_table() extras() controls missing value replacement string (default "---"). add_group_colors() now accepts vector colors (one per group) addition single color groups.

title: sumExtras 1.0.0 (2026-02-09)
text: Data dictionaries now use lowercase column names (variable, description) convention. Title-case names (Variable, Description) still work — column matching case-insensitive. extras() now handles tbl_regression gracefully: overall pval silently ignored (regression tables already model p-values), bold_p() applied automatically. warnings using extras() default arguments regression tables. Removed startup message. package now loads silently. Dropped purrr Imports (4 dependencies instead 5). New vignettes: vignette("options") vignette("themes").

title: sumExtras 0.3.1 (2026-01-22)
text: Added quiet = TRUE default use_jama_theme() suppress messages {gtsummary} {sumExtras}. Resolves issue #12 (thank @RaymondBalise). extras() longer warns called default arguments non-stratified tables. Previously, calling extras(tbl) table without argument warn even though user didn’t explicitly request overall pval features. Now warnings fire users explicitly request features can’t applied: extras(non_stratified_tbl) - Silent (applies basic formatting) extras(non_stratified_tbl, overall = TRUE) - Warns (user explicitly requested) extras(non_stratified_tbl, pval = TRUE) - Warns (user explicitly requested)
